messages:
alex_support: FYI we got an escalation from Greenline — delegated admin (j.taylor@greenline.com) suddenly gets 403 on Project Settings for project `greenline-prod`. Customer says this started after their Okta attribute normalization rolled out yesterday. Screenshot attached. Repro steps they sent: 1) SSO login 2) navigate to /org/greenline/projects/greenline-prod/settings 3) 403. Any quick remediation?

maria_cs: Thanks Alex — can you grab the exact time and the user session id? Also ask customer if they recently renamed any groups in Okta.

alex_support: Timestamp from customer: 2026-03-16T20:14:12Z. Session id: sess_7f9c4a. They said they removed a prefix on a handful of groups (was `GLINE-` -> stripped).

devon_idp: That sounds like the group-name -> role mapping broke. When we map SAML/SCIM groups by display name, any normalization/truncation on IdP side can drop the mapping. Can you fetch the SAML assertion we received for that session? Run the auth-audit lookup: 

```
# internal command
redwood-authctl get-assertion --session sess_7f9c4a --output raw
```

Look for groups claim (urn:okta:groups) — if the renamed groups are missing or different, mapping is the cause.

sam_sre: Also check SCIM sync logs for delays. There's a known race where Okta normalization + SCIM delta can desync for ~5-10m. Quick workaround: assign the missing role directly via API so the user can continue. Example: 

```
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/PROJ_ID/memberships" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDCONN_SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_email":"j.taylor@greenline.com","role":"project-admin"}'
```

That should bypass IdP mapping until they fix their mapping.

alex_support: I ran the trace and pulled the assertion — group list is empty (Okta returned normalized names that no longer match our expected mapping). Reproduced 403 in our audit logs: `authz: role not found for principal groups: []`. Trying the API patch now.

provision-bot: role-assignment-succeeded: {"project_id":"PROJ_ID","user":"j.taylor@greenline.com","role":"project-admin","actor":"alex_support","ts":"2026-03-16T20:23:01Z"}

maria_cs: Nice — confirm with customer that they can access settings now and tell them we recommended the API patch as a short-term fix. Also ask them to re-add the original group prefix or update mapping.

devon_idp: I'll open an internal ticket for identity to recommend permanent fixes: (1) prefer group external_id or group UUID for mapping instead of display name, (2) add defensive mapping rules for normalized names, (3) add an alert when SCIM group->role mappings drop to zero for an org.

sam_sre: For runbook: if customer reports again, either re-invite/re-assign role via API or request that the IdP team re-emit group claims (or add a transient mapping). Also watch for SCIM sync lag; we should set a temporary 15m window on our side to accept recent group name variants.

alex_support: Customer confirmed access restored. I advised them we'll follow up with a postmortem explaining root cause and recommended mapping changes. Closing this ticket once devon creates the idp ticket. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the CS case and add the API-assign workaround to KB.

devon_idp: Ticket created: IDP-4023 — investigating normalization + mapping drift. Will add remediation ETA.

sam_sre: Marking as resolved in Slack, keep watch for recurrence.
